name: Lamp
summary: Table lamp with a drum shade on a round base; add anim on for a warm glow. Use for bedside, desk and cosy room scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the base rests on y; put it on a table by setting y to the table top

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 350 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: on = lamp switched on with a warm glow

author: krakujs
